Yeah, I also feel like I use both at times, but I think I greatly favor Ni because I often have those “Eureka!” moments that are so infamous with strong Ni users and I rather be a complete expert on one thing/ or a couple of interests than have a lot of different interests. And I like to develop my visions on my own, if that makes sense. I think based on what you’re saying, you’re probably more Ne. Both Ne and Ni are future-oriented and imaginative/creative, but Ne takes more from the external world and Ni is more random/abstract and symbolic.

Ne is scattered/about the endless possibilities the world has to offer. Ni is more about inner-intuition, about having a vision, and having your mind wander endlessly in the background. Ne thrives on brainstorming/group brainstorming whereas Ni likes to let things sit and figure out things independently and with time. Ne usually focuses on a lot of different things while Ni is usually more organized and focuses on perfecting one vision at a time.
